description: Use only when the user says to pause (e.g. "pause 3"); agents never call it on their own. All action tools on the slot are refused and any browser_wait in progress stops at once. An action already sent to Chrome finishes. Reading still works. Applies immediately to agents in other Claude sessions too. all=true pauses every running slot.

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-d26d".

slot.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

items.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

name: slot_pause
title: Pause slot
